purpose: The sounds every Oasis may ship and plays, the owner's own included (one set everywhere). Each entry carries its own licence line; 'replaces' (optional) names the Mixkit sound it stands in for.
howToChange: This file is the whole list (Hipster owns the picks). library: each sound (id, file, licence, source, optional 'replaces' = the Mixkit id it stands in for, optional 'volume' 0-1.5, default 1). picks: key -> library id; a pick plays in every Oasis, the owner's included. Keys the code plays: a spell id (its cast; the spellbook's sound), 'bolt-cast' (any bolt without its own pick), 'impact-fire' / 'impact-lightning' / 'impact-ice' then 'impact' (a bolt landing), 'conjure' (an agent conjuring, keep about 4.8 s), 'portal' (a form portal opening), 'summon', 'sky-change', 'ground-change' (3 s changes), 'ui-confirm' (a menu click), 'brush-start', 'brush-loop' (looped while drawing), 'brush-end', 'place-groundslam' (the Ground Slam conjuration). An entry may list 'variants' (more takes of the same sound): one plays at random each time. A key without a pick keeps its old sound or stays silent. The code (src/lib/spell-sounds.ts) bundles this file; change nothing else. Check: npx vitest run src/lib/__tests__/spell-sounds-shipped.test.ts
format: OGG Vorbis q3, mono, 44.1 kHz, levelled to the Mixkit sound it replaces (EBU R128). Made by Battlemage with ffmpeg: trimmed, layered, an echo tail on the short ones.
license: Per entry: each sound's 'licence' says what it is (CC0 from rubberduck on OpenGameArt, or made with ElevenLabs on the owner's paid plan). Files under /audio/spells-cc0/ ship (the folder's name is older than its contents). Files under /audio/spells-own/ do not ('ships': false: the owner's own voice until he says yes); a release plays the entry's 'fallback' for the picks that name them. A 'fallback' on a shipped entry is the CC0 sound to play if its file is missing.
